title: Bad Teacher's Equation
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-school freshman Atsushi Arisawa enrolls at a delinquent-heavy high school to be near his childhood crush 'Ma-chan', but the school nurse is actually Ma-chan's look-alike brother Masayoshi, while his classmate Kouji, whom he once promised to marry as a child, keeps pursuing him (AniList; MangaUpdates; ANN review). A ten-volume 1990s BL comedy by Kazuma Kodaka with love triangles, a time skip to college, and a parallel romance between two teachers (ANN; MangaUpdates).
life_message: It plays romantic pursuit and mistaken identity for comedy, suggesting love can grow toward someone unexpected (to verify).

content.note: Comic tone that reviewers say turns uncomfortable (ANN; AIPT).

Romance between a high-school student and a school nurse/teacher (ANN; AniList Age Gap; MangaUpdates School Nurse-Student Relationship). Unwanted physical contact, groping and an attempted rape of teen characters, played lightly (AIPT; ANN). No explicit scenes described in vol. 1 reviews; MangaDex rates it safe. A teacher's romantic feelings for his brother form a subplot (ANN; MangaUpdates).
Harassment and persistent unwanted advances treated as romantic comedy (ANN; AIPT).
